# cork-nav-tabs

A row of navigation tabs, for moving between related pages or views, e.g. the sections of a record.
The tab bar only: content below it is up to the page.
Only top-level items are shown: sub menus and fields are ignored.
The tab bar keeps its own light background on dark and category brand sections, as campus's does.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navAriaLabel` | `String` | Label for the nav. Default: 'Tabs'. Attribute: nav-aria-label. |
| `secondary` | `Boolean` | Uses campus's secondary style: a transparent bar with a bottom border and smaller text. Attribute: secondary. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Tabs: a/button elements, or a ul/ol of li elements. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM by [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md). See its examples for the markup formats. Mark the current tab with data-active, on its li or its link/button: it's highlighted, and gets aria-current ('page' on links, 'true' on buttons). Move data-active to change tabs, e.g. on a route change. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-nav-item-click` | Fired when a rendered link or button is clicked, with the clicked item in detail.navItem. See [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md). |

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-nav-tabs';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkNavTabs from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-nav-tabs/cork-nav-tabs.js';
```

**Links**

```html
<cork-nav-tabs>
  <ul>
    <li data-active><a href="/record/1">Overview</a></li>
    <li><a href="/record/1/holdings">Holdings</a></li>
    <li><a href="/record/1/citations">Citations</a></li>
  </ul>
</cork-nav-tabs>
```

**Buttons**

```html
<cork-nav-tabs nav-aria-label="Views">
  <button data-active>List</button>
  <button>Grid</button>
</cork-nav-tabs>
```

**Handling button clicks**

```js
tabs.addEventListener('cork-nav-item-click', e => {
  tabs.querySelector('[data-active]')?.removeAttribute('data-active');
  e.detail.navItem.ele.setAttribute('data-active', '');
});
```

**Secondary**

```html
<cork-nav-tabs secondary>
  <a href="/record/1" data-active>Overview</a>
  <a href="/record/1/holdings">Holdings</a>
</cork-nav-tabs>
```
